definitions.gloss: end-of-day meeting; closing assembly; wrap-up meeting
definitions.explanation: A brief meeting held at the end of a school day or work shift to review the day's events, share information, and make announcements. Paired with the morning meeting.

examples.japanese: {終礼|しゅうれい}の{時間|じかん}だ。
examples.english: It's time for the end-of-day meeting.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}が{終礼|しゅうれい}で{明日|あした}の{予定|よてい}を{伝|つた}えた。
examples.english: The teacher communicated tomorrow's schedule at the end-of-day assembly.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}では{毎日|まいにち}{終礼|しゅうれい}で{安全|あんぜん}{確認|かくにん}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: At the factory, a safety check is conducted at the daily end-of-day meeting.

notes:
Composed of {終|しゅう} (end) and {礼|れい} (ceremony, greeting). The counterpart of {朝礼|ちょうれい} (morning assembly). In schools, {終礼|しゅうれい} is a brief gathering at the end of the last period where the teacher makes announcements and students report on the day. In workplaces, especially manufacturing and construction, it serves as a daily wrap-up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終礼|しゅうれい}の{時間|じかん}: time for the closing meeting
- {終礼|しゅうれい}で{報告|ほうこく}する: to report at the closing meeting
- {朝礼|ちょうれい}と{終礼|しゅうれい}: morning and closing assemblies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {朝礼|ちょうれい}: morning assembly — the corresponding start-of-day meeting
- {帰|かえ}りの{会|かい}: closing homeroom — the school-specific term used in many elementary and middle schools
- ミーティング: meeting — general loanword for any meeting
